description: Add multiple company template presets (product_sales, marketing_agency, data_solutions, digital_agency, entertainment_company) under agentwork/presets/companies/ and add auto-team factory at agentwork/factory.py
steps: Create agentwork/presets/companies/__init__.py that exports all company fleet classes

Create agentwork/presets/companies/product_sales.py - A ProductSalesCompany class/function that creates a fleet of agents: ProductManager (tools: product_catalog, pricing_engine, inventory_checker), SalesRep (tools: sales_pipeline, deal_closer, quote_generator), OrderFulfillment (tools: order_processor, shipping_tracker, invoice_generator), CustomerSuccess (tools: account_manager, renewal_tracker, upsell_identifier). Each returns agents with relevant tools following the pattern in agentwork/presets/company/ceo.py. The company function returns a list of pre-configured Agent instances.

Create agentwork/presets/companies/marketing_agency.py - A MarketingAgencyCompany class/function with agents: CampaignStrategist (tools: campaign_planner, audience_segmenter, budget_allocator), SocialMediaManager (tools: post_scheduler, engagement_tracker, hashtag_optimizer), SEOSpecialist (tools: keyword_researcher, backlink_analyzer, rank_tracker), ContentProducer (tools: blog_writer, video_scripter, infographic_designer), AdBuyer (tools: ad_placement, bid_optimizer, roi_calculator).

Create agentwork/presets/companies/data_solutions.py - A DataSolutionsCompany with agents: DataEngineer (tools: data_ingester, etl_pipeline, schema_validator), DataAnalyst (tools: query_runner, statistics_calculator, trend_analyzer), DataCleaner (tools: deduplicator, null_handler, format_normalizer), ReportGenerator (tools: dashboard_builder, chart_creator, pdf_exporter), MLEngineer (tools: model_trainer, prediction_runner, feature_extractor).

Create agentwork/presets/companies/digital_agency.py - A DigitalAgencyCompany with agents: FrontendDev (tools: ui_builder, responsive_tester, accessibility_checker), BackendDev (tools: api_builder, database_designer, auth_implementer), QAEngineer (tools: test_runner, bug_reporter, load_tester), DevOpsEngineer (tools: deployer, monitor_setup, log_analyzer), UXDesigner (tools: wireframe_creator, prototype_builder, usability_tester).

Create agentwork/presets/companies/entertainment_company.py - An EntertainmentCompany with agents: ContentProducer (tools: script_writer, scene_planner, talent_coordinator), Scheduler (tools: release_planner, event_coordinator, calendar_manager), Distributor (tools: platform_publisher, syndication_manager, rights_tracker), AudienceManager (tools: fan_engagement, feedback_collector, community_moderator).

Create agentwork/factory.py with a TeamFactory class: Given a task description string, it analyzes keywords to select the appropriate company template (or mix agents from multiple templates), creates the team, and returns a CompanyOrchestrator with those agents ready to execute. Keyword matching maps task descriptions to relevant company types. Method: create_team(task_description: str) -> CompanyOrchestrator.
Update agentwork/presets/__init__.py to also export the new company fleet factories and TeamFactory
Update agentwork/__init__.py to export TeamFactory from agentwork.factory
Create tests/test_companies.py testing all 5 new company presets - instantiation, tool availability, tool execution, custom naming. At least 20 test cases.
Create tests/test_factory.py testing TeamFactory - task description routing to correct company, mixed team creation, unknown task handling. At least 10 test cases.
Ensure all existing tests still pass (166 from before + new tests from FEAT-001)
acceptance_criteria: 5 new company preset files exist under agentwork/presets/companies/
Each company preset creates a list of specialized agents with relevant tools
agentwork/factory.py exists with TeamFactory class that auto-creates teams from task descriptions
tests/test_companies.py passes with at least 20 test cases
tests/test_factory.py passes with at least 10 test cases
All previously passing tests still pass
TeamFactory can select appropriate agents based on task description keywords
All new modules are importable from the top-level agentwork package
findings: All 256 tests pass (210 existing + 46 new). 5 company presets created with 23 total agents and 69 tools. TeamFactory keyword detection and team creation works correctly. All modules importable from top-level agentwork package.
